body:
## Outcome and current status

The legal draft and UI exist, but the text must describe the app and providers that actually ship. Complete the evidence and publication work rather than treating a draft as compliance.

Part of #817. This is a planning/coordination deliverable. No delivery milestone label is earned merely by filing it.

## Scope and entry points

PR #781; docs/legal/; docs/specs/argus-execution-board.md Release gates; app and third-party SDK privacy manifests

No invented retention guarantees, unsupported legal promises, published policy changes or feature retirement without the proper approval. PR #781 remains the existing draft owner.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Finish PR #781's entity, contact, actual retention/log/backups, deletion, provider sharing, permitted-source and counsel-review items. Preserve the locked deletion copy and actual pending/fallback semantics.
- [ ] Publish approved Spanish/English Privacy and Terms at the agreed cuadrao.ai locations and verify signed-in reachability.
- [ ] Map actual collection, sharing, tracking and deletion to App Store privacy answers, app/SDK manifests and required API reasons. Verify facts against configured services.
- [ ] Audit camera, location, photo, microphone and notification purposes against reachable release behavior; remove unused permission requests safely and test denial recovery.
- [ ] Verify explicit AI disclosure against the shared consent implementation, including each included provider and voice/document path.
- [ ] Assess purchase and user-content rules only for included functionality; record applicable requirements and approved exclusions.
- [ ] Review current Apple guidance at execution time and retain the dated source links and completed audit.

- [ ] Include embeddings, memory sensitivity assessment and any selected external evaluation/tracing tool in the actual data-flow and retention inventory. Reconcile memory/index deletion and revoked access with the implemented policy. Braintrust remains optional; do not add it or claim its retention practices without a separate selection and verification.

## Dependencies and parallel work

Data-flow inventory, legal review and SDK audit can run with implementation. Final signoff depends on actual enabled behavior, not just a proposed feature list.

Completion prerequisites: #818. Native blocked-by links record these same prerequisites. They gate completion, not useful preparation. Existing linked issues keep their own acceptance and approval boundaries.

## Verification and closure

Use the approved scope in #817. Before a completion claim, record the original/current integration SHAs, PR head, relevant API/build identity, environment and runtime mode. Retain durable evidence for happy path, interruption/recovery, authorization and relaunch where relevant. Use focused deterministic checks and the real affected journey; document non-applicable checks instead of inventing passes. Physical journeys use the shared Mac/device scheduler.

Close with the accepted document/audit and named evidence. Activation is not applicable to this issue itself.

Any implementation requires its bounded assignment and approved contracts. Preserve default-off gates until authorized. Plan rollback at the changed owner; schema changes require backup and forward-recovery or rollback evidence before hosted execution. No merge, deployment, hosted mutation or paid provider run is authorized by this issue.

## Planning evidence

Reviewed 2026-10-04 CT against integration `76b6afcb4080c6e639e8c50bdabf51621d862190`, the current execution board, master plan and open issue inventory. This is repository/GitHub planning, not a new runtime acceptance result. Deployed API/web/workflow SHAs and live runtime mode are omitted because no hosted inspection was performed. Revalidate specific gaps at assignment time.
